verdict: Meta ROAS surged this week, but purchase volume remains thin and uneven.
narrative: Meta advertising delivered a strong ROAS of 3.54 over the last 28 days, with $5,311.58 in revenue on $1,500.31 in spend — and a sharp 7-day spike driven largely by a single high-value purchase day on August 17. That one day accounts for most of the week-over-week surge, so while the number is real, it reflects a single event rather than a steady purchase pattern across the period. Google Ads carried no spend or activity this period, so Meta is carrying the full paid load. On the local side, Google Business Profile engagement dropped 35% week-over-week, with three consecutive days of zero actions — we're monitoring this closely and will look to reinvigorate local visibility heading into next period. The funnel test and UTM tracking milestone is due August 31, which will give us a cleaner read on purchase attribution going forward.
